authority.ground_truth: CoreRPG only; offline snapshot is an explicit non-authoritative fixture
authority.reference: Star Trek defines generation constraints, rarity, protected canon, ecology, archaeology and presentation gates
authority.sensors: F06 and existing detectable_signature_model + observable_entity_model own actual detection resolution
authority.science: B06 owns research, validation, review and technology transfer; B07 only provides physical subjects and exploration evidence
authority.historical: B05 may consume accepted, attributed events; B07 never writes B05 history directly
authority.ownership: B02 political rights and CoreRPG authoritative possessions; excavating does not transfer artifact ownership
authority.host: HOST validates sessions and commands only, does not author world phenomena
authority.renderer: UE5/NAP only displays accepted state; AI has no direct mutation rights
authority.future_blocks: B08 crisis, B09 missions and B10 scheduler remain unimplemented

families.omega: special authored mission obligation from LORE-02 D remains open; never a random technology, routine encounter or mission auto-spawn

baseline.generation_trigger: authoritative world generation or accepted causal world event, never sensor, proximity, camera, quest or NPC dialogue
baseline.identity: p2b07:<campaign_id>:<stable_slot_ref> reference-only, versioned migration required for any change
baseline.probability: rarity_bps in [0,10000], using roll < rarity_bps; values synthetic, no galaxy-wide canonical frequencies asserted
baseline.no_reroll: persist materialization success OR empty-slot decision; no retry when camera loads or player arrives
slot_constraints: accepted preexisting formation or archaeological-origin fact
baseline.materialization: reference snapshot record only; in production CoreRPG accepts/rejects actual creation
archaeological_integrity: actual material strata with stable refs
no algorithmic assignment of modern ownership
recovery requires explicit custodian and permit
no transfer or commercial inventory on discovery

observation.source: accepted sensor_observation fact and instrument/operator provenance (fixture declares this; runtime must attest)
observation.scientific_limit: 2 independent actors and instruments needed to create supported_not_certain interpretation in reference; not universal law of Star Trek physics
observation.uncertainty: unknown origin, risk and interpretation may persist forever; false positives and contradictory signals are legitimate

states.anomaly: dormant -> active/quiescent/spent via explicitly accepted physical_transition cause only
states.archaeology: stable_ruin -> eroding_ruin -> lost_ruin via accepted cause only
states.hazard: a B07 hazard observation is not hull damage, a B08 crisis, or a B09 mission
states.persistence: CoreRPG must own temporal transitions; reference processes ordered supplied events; no background galaxy scheduler

observation_privacy.rule: public source and authorization do not imply instant propagation; PADD/AI expose filtered projections, not the full truth or undisclosed artifacts

forbidden: auto-instantiating the Bajoran wormhole, temporal playable travel, new route
silently replacing a canon anomaly or source timeline
creating artifacts because a mission needs them
auto-generating political crisis, war, rescue or quest
technology unlock, world technology band or ship modification
artifact seizure, cultural appropriation, excavation without permits
sensors that create phenomena or omniscient scientist AI
using user location, player rank or LOD to decide truth
importing offline simulator into CoreRPG as a second authoritative writer

replay.migration: new generator revisions must not reinterpret already materialized sites, ancient cultures or event history

fixture.sources: all facts already accepted by fixture author, not verified by CoreRPG
fixture.example: Lira subspace ripple + Lyra ruins and artifact stratigraphy; two sensors, independent interpretations, custodian consent, lifecycle change, delayed disclosure
fixture.resource_cost: not modeled; source of truth for resource accounting remains B04 and CoreRPG

runtime_gates: CoreRPG authoritative event and slot API
